title: Choose the visual direction for HYBRID Electromechanical
question: Both top options honor your BAU CARGO cutout aesthetic, #f4f5fa / #4b53a4 / #ffffff palette, and Pattern.png texture. Pick the structural composition to build.

options.label: MEP Coordination Ledger
options.lineage: Architectural MEP riser & coordination sheets fused with BAU CARGO cutout cards
options.thesis: Cutout engineering crews break the top edge of #f4f5fa cards along a shared #4b53a4 datum rail.
options.viewport: Full-width HYBRID display wordmark over the 3-tier hard-hat plant cutout, with a #4b53a4 mission banner below.
options.risk: Technical datum tags must stay minimal so the page remains breathable.

raised.raise: A continuous vertical riser line connects all 8 sections down a shared axis.
Interactive discipline pills filter and highlight matching MEP services and projects.
Transparent cutout figures overlap and break out of card frames for spatial depth.
Stats counters and project cards snap along a fixed-pitch horizontal rail.

options.label: BAU CARGO Cutout Bento
options.lineage: Direct translation of your BAU CARGO reference into HYBRID's brand system
options.thesis: Colossal wordmark header, floating cutout plant hero, and rounded #f4f5fa bento cards with arrow-pill actions.
options.viewport: Giant 'HYBRID' display type spanning the top above the cutout MEP plant and pill CTAs, followed by a rounded #4b53a4 About banner.
options.risk: Closest to the reference layout you shared, trading experimental novelty for proven conversion clarity.

options.label: Stenciled Spec Grammar
options.lineage: Industrial stenciled crate & specification tag grammar
options.thesis: Every MEP zone and cutout assembly is tagged with bold quoted spec plates and diagonal structure stripes.
options.viewport: Quoted 'HYBRID MEP' headline with stenciled division tags and cutout plant structure.
options.case: Translates cleanly into industrial equipment tagging, though slightly busier than the reference.
options.risk: Quoted labels can feel stylized if overused on formal B2B copy.

options.label: Scale-Contrast Specimen Grid
options.lineage: Interactive typographic specimen grid with live axis scale
options.thesis: Enormous display typography and numerical counters carry the hierarchy against tiny technical labels and cutout plates.
options.viewport: Edge-to-edge 'HYBRID' display letters with interactive weight/scale emphasis and cutout MEP plant.
options.case: Echoes the massive 'bau cargo' display wordmark from your inspiration image with ultra-minimal copy.
options.risk: Requires careful image scaling so typography does not overpower the cutout photos.

options.label: Coptic Exposed Binding
options.thesis: Sections strung along an exposed vertical spine that opens flat.
options.viewport: Two-page flat spread divided by a stitched spine.
options.case: Bookbinding craft does not match UAE electromechanical contracting.
options.risk: Reads like an editorial publication rather than an MEP contractor.
options.kept: Visible vertical riser spine connecting sections along a shared axis.

options.label: Multi-View Swatch Sheet
options.lineage: Reference sheet with interactive swatch-to-region highlighting
options.thesis: Four views ranged across the sheet controlled by interactive swatches.
options.viewport: Four discipline views linked to a row of interactive category pills.
options.case: Amateur character sheet aesthetic conflicts with B2B engineering authority.
options.risk: Too informal for corporate and government MEP tenders.
options.kept: Interactive discipline pills that highlight corresponding service and project regions.

options.label: Torn Layer Wall
options.lineage: Layered poster wall with torn reveals
options.thesis: Stacked layers peeled back to reveal earlier project strata.
options.viewport: Stacked project strata with overlapping foreground cutouts.
options.case: Distressed photocopy textures contradict precision MEP engineering.
options.risk: Clashes with the clean, breathable BAU CARGO aesthetic.
options.kept: Cutout figures breaking past card borders to create foreground/background depth.

options.label: Perforated Select Rail
options.lineage: Film cutting bench with horizontal frame rail
options.thesis: Sections strung as frames along a fixed-pitch horizontal rail.
options.viewport: Horizontal project rail with fixed-pitch frame snapping.
options.case: Film editing metaphors do not resonate with construction stakeholders.
options.kept: Fixed-pitch horizontal carousel snapping for the Projects showcase.

canonCard.label: Corporate MEP Standard
canonCard.thesis: Conventional UAE corporate MEP contracting website executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Left-aligned hero copy with CTA buttons beside the cutout plant image, over a 4-column stats bar.
canonCard.risk: Familiar corporate layout without the distinctive BAU CARGO oversized wordmark and bento rhythm.
